## What this notebook did not do

Where a step needed a package, model or reference this environment does not ship, the cell said so and continued. An existing message means that step did not run — do not read its absence as a clean result.

Next steps that belong elsewhere:

- **Raw reads to counts** — Space Ranger (Visium) and SAW (Stereo-seq) produce the matrix/GEF/GEM; they are wrappers, not notebook cells. Cell segmentation for Stereo-seq cellbin is done upstream by SAW cellCut.
- **cell2location / tangram-sc / stereopy / liana core** — pip-only (torch or compiled deps) and cannot enter a pure-conda locked environment. Deconvolution here uses scipy NNLS against a single-cell reference; cell-cell communication uses squidpy ligrec with a shipped ligand-receptor resource. Use a project environment for the model-based tools.
- **R / Bioconductor route** — OSTA's native SpatialExperiment/Seurat route is a future sibling skill; this plugin is the Python route.
attribution: Analysis structure and teaching text are an original distillation of OSTA — Orchestrating Spatial Transcriptomics Analysis with Bioconductor (Crowell et al., CC BY 4.0) — https://github.com/lmweber/OSTA/, with single-cell best practices (Apache 2.0). The code is original to this plugin and runs in the private plugin:spatial environment (scanpy 1.12 + squidpy 1.8 + spatialdata 0.8): no install cells, no Colab paths, and the config cell is the single place to tune parameters.

platform.comment: auto detects from the input; or visium, visium-hd, stereoseq

bin_size.comment: Stereo-seq square bin / Visium HD bin side in DNB or µm units; null reads the bin the file already carries. Choosing a bin is a biological decision, not a default

cellbin.comment: read Stereo-seq cellbin (segmented cells) instead of square bins; segmentation is done upstream by SAW

min_genes.comment: minimum genes per spot/bin/cell; lower than single-cell because spatial units are shallower

min_counts.comment: minimum UMIs per spatial unit; below this a unit is likely empty

max_counts.comment: maximum UMIs per spatial unit; null disables the upper gate

mt_max.comment: maximum mitochondrial percent; spatial tissue tolerates more than dissociated cells

ribo_pattern.comment: ribosomal gene regex; fraction is context, not a gate

hb_pattern.comment: hemoglobin gene regex; marks blood contamination

quantiles.comment: distribution quantiles reported for each QC metric

normalization.comment: normalize by library size then log1p

scale_factor.comment: counts per spatial unit after normalize_total

n_hvg.comment: number of variable genes to keep for PCA/clustering

hvg_flavor.comment: HVG flavor on the counts layer; seurat_v3 needs scikit-misc, which this environment ships

dims.comment: PCs used for neighbours and UMAP

resolution.comment: Leiden clustering granularity; a list sweeps several resolutions

run_umap.comment: compute the UMAP embedding (expression space, not spatial)

seed.comment: random seed, so clustering and embedding repeat exactly

neighbor_method.comment: spatial adjacency: knn, radius, delaunay or grid; Visium hex grid suits grid/delaunay, Stereo-seq bins suit knn/radius

n_neighs.comment: neighbours for knn adjacency; 6 matches the Visium hexagonal spot layout

radius.comment: radius for radius adjacency, in coordinate units; null derives it from spacing

coord_key.comment: obsm key holding the spatial coordinates

group_by.comment: obs column defining the groups for markers, annotation and spatial statistics

test_use.comment: marker test: wilcoxon, t-test, t-test_overestim_var or logreg

logfc_threshold.comment: minimum absolute log2 fold change for a marker

min_pct.comment: minimum fraction of group units expressing a marker

top_n.comment: markers printed and plotted per group

panel_path.comment: marker panel JSON; null uses the built-in example panel

mapping_path.comment: cluster -> label JSON overriding the panel scores

label_column.comment: obs column written with the cell-type labels

min_score.comment: minimum panel score; below it a cluster stays unassigned

svg_method.comment: spatially variable gene statistic: moran (Moran's I) or geary (Geary's C)

svg_corr_method.comment: multiple-testing correction for SVG p-values; a statsmodels method name (fdr_bh, bonferroni, holm). benjamini-hochberg is accepted as an alias for fdr_bh

n_perms.comment: permutations for neighbourhood enrichment and ligand-receptor significance

cooc_interval.comment: number of distance intervals for the co-occurrence probability

ripley_mode.comment: Ripley point-pattern statistic: L (default), F or G

ripley_simulations.comment: Monte Carlo simulations for Ripley's point-pattern envelope

niche_column.comment: obs column written with spatial niche / tissue domain labels

niche_mode.comment: niche aggregation mode: composition (neighbourhood cell-type profile) or expression (spatially smoothed HVG expression)

niche_resolution.comment: Leiden resolution for spatial niche segmentation

niche_hops.comment: spatial graph hops aggregated per unit for niche segmentation

niche_use_deconvolution.comment: use obsm['deconvolution'] proportions instead of group_by labels in composition niche mode

root_cluster.comment: starting cluster/cell type for diffusion pseudotime; null selects automatically with a warning note

gene_sets_path.comment: JSON mapping program name -> gene list for spatial sc.tl.score_genes; null skips gene-program scoring

paga_threshold.comment: minimum PAGA connectivity weight reported and plotted

reference_path.comment: single-cell reference .h5ad for deconvolution; null skips deconvolution with a message

reference_cell_type_key.comment: obs column in the reference naming cell types

deconv_method.comment: deconvolution solver: nnls (scipy, in-plugin); cell2location needs a project environment

interactions_path.comment: ligand-receptor table for CCC; null uses the shipped resource so ligrec runs offline

ccc_threshold.comment: p-value threshold for significant ligand-receptor interactions

stratify_by.comment: obs column (e.g. niche) to run niche-stratified ligrec in addition to global communication; null skips stratification

group_column.comment: condition/sample column for cross-sample spatial differential and niche dynamics; null = skip

min_units.comment: minimum spatial units for a group to enter a spatial differential contrast

figures_dir.comment: directory for the PNG copies of every plot

plot_tag.comment: suffix for the QC plots; the filter pass re-tags them after

steps.title: Map clusters and genes in space
Score clusters against a marker panel
Neighbourhood enrichment, co-occurrence, centrality and Ripley's L

1.title: Module 01 — Spatial QC
1.intro:
Quality control on raw spatial counts: per-unit gene/UMI/mitochondrial distributions
and threshold filtering with a report of what each threshold removed. Reads a Visium
matrix directory or .h5, a Stereo-seq GEF/GEM, or an .h5ad with spatial coordinates.

Original distillation of OSTA (CC BY 4.0); the code is original to this plugin.

2.title: Module 02 — Preprocess and cluster
2.intro:
The QC chain plus normalization, highly variable genes (seurat_v3 on counts),
scaled PCA, Leiden clustering and a UMAP in expression space. Spatial coordinates are
kept in obsm['spatial'] throughout so every later step can map results back to tissue.

Original distillation of OSTA (CC BY 4.0).

3.title: Module 03 — Spatial domains and markers
3.intro:
The clustered chain plus the spatial adjacency graph, cluster/gene maps in tissue
space, per-cluster marker tables (Wilcoxon) and marker-panel annotation. The adjacency
graph is the prerequisite for every spatial statistic that follows.

Original distillation of OSTA (CC BY 4.0).

4.title: Module 04 — Spatially variable genes, neighbourhoods and niches
4.intro:
The annotated chain plus Moran's I spatially variable genes, neighbourhood
enrichment / co-occurrence / centrality / Ripley's L, and UTAG-style spatial
niche segmentation.

Original distillation of OSTA (CC BY 4.0).

5.title: Module 05 — Deconvolution and communication
5.intro:
The annotated chain plus cell-type proportion deconvolution (scipy NNLS against a
single-cell reference) and ligand-receptor cell-cell communication (squidpy ligrec with
a shipped offline resource, optionally stratified by niche). Deconvolution needs a
reference .h5ad; without one the cell says so and continues.

Original distillation of OSTA (CC BY 4.0).

6.title: Module 06 — Full spatial chain
6.intro:
Every capability in order: QC, preprocess, cluster, spatial maps, markers,
annotation, SVG, neighbourhoods (enrichment, co-occurrence, centrality, Ripley),
spatial niches, PAGA/DPT spatial trajectory, deconvolution, communication and
cross-sample differential spatial patterns. Steps that need a missing reference
or package report the gap and continue.

Original distillation of OSTA (CC BY 4.0).
